dialogues.jp: 「ふあ〜」
dialogues.en: "Yaaaaawn."
dialogues.text: "Yaaaaawn."

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きく伸びをする。
dialogues.en: I had a good long stretch.
dialogues.text: I had a good long stretch.

dialogues.jp: 朝の空気を胸いっぱいに吸い込む。
dialogues.en: I took a big breath of morning air.
dialogues.text: I took a big breath of morning air.

dialogues.jp: これもまた、至福の時かな。
dialogues.en: This is the best time of the day.
dialogues.text: This is the best time of the day.

dialogues.jp: しかし、伸びたところでやはり眠気は取れない。
dialogues.en: But not even the stretch could shake off my sleepiness.
dialogues.text: But not even the stretch could shake off my sleepiness.

dialogues.jp: 俺には眠り神が憑りついているのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Did I anger Morpheus or something?
dialogues.text: Did I anger Morpheus or something?

dialogues.jp: 今度、環に｛はら／祓｝ってもらうか……。
dialogues.en:
Maybe I should try and get Tamaki to exorcise him out of
me...
dialogues.text:
Maybe I should try and get Tamaki to exorcise him out of
me...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます。朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: ナイスタイミングで環に会う。
dialogues.en: Tamaki called out to me, excellent timing.
dialogues.text: Tamaki called out to me, excellent timing.

dialogues.jp: 「うい〜っす」
dialogues.en: "Good maaaawnn....ing."
dialogues.text: "Good maaaawnn....ing."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら。まだ眠そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Oh my, are you still feeling sleepy?"
dialogues.text: "Oh my, are you still feeling sleepy?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、まあな」
dialogues.en: "Pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Pretty much."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What had happened?"
dialogues.text: "What had happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、昨日ちょっと深夜番組見てて……」
dialogues.en:
"I just stayed up last night to watch a late-night TV
program..."
dialogues.text:
"I just stayed up last night to watch a late-night TV
program..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「深夜番組？」
dialogues.en: "Late-night TV program?"
dialogues.text: "Late-night TV program?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh."
dialogues.text: "Ahh."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どんな番組ですか？」
dialogues.en: "What kind of program would that be?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of program would that be?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「『ペンタゴン』って番組で、出題者が正しく
　回答している人を当てるってやつ」
dialogues.en:
"It was a documentary about the Pentagon. They were talking
about how they extracted the truth from people who they
interrogated."
dialogues.text:
"It was a documentary about the Pentagon. They were talking
about how they extracted the truth from people who they
interrogated."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「へえ。そんな番組があるんですね。初めて聞
　きました」
dialogues.en:
"Heh, that would be the first time I've heard of such a TV
program..."
dialogues.text:
"Heh, that would be the first time I've heard of such a TV
program..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「面白いんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Was it interesting?"
dialogues.text: "Was it interesting?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「まあまあな。深夜番組だから、マニア受けの
　ものが多いけど」
dialogues.en:
"Quite. They show all the weird stuff during the graveyard
period."
dialogues.text:
"Quite. They show all the weird stuff during the graveyard
period."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、今度是非見てみますね」
dialogues.en: "Well, I shall make a note to watch it next time, then."
dialogues.text: "Well, I shall make a note to watch it next time, then."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いや、女の子はあまり見なくてもいいんじゃ
　ないか？」
dialogues.en:
"Nah, I don't think girls should be watching such a
program."
dialogues.text:
"Nah, I don't think girls should be watching such a
program."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　どうしてですか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Why?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Well, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Well, that's..."

dialogues.jp:
女の子が目を伏せたくなるような番組もあるだ
ろうし。
dialogues.en:
I don't think it's the kind of program that girls would look
very highly upon.
dialogues.text:
I don't think it's the kind of program that girls would look
very highly upon.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様が見てるものって、興味があるんです」
dialogues.en:
"I do have an interest in it, as it seemed to have piqued
yours."
dialogues.text:
"I do have an interest in it, as it seemed to have piqued
yours."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様と、同じものを見たいんですよ」
dialogues.en: "I would like to view the same things you do."
dialogues.text: "I would like to view the same things you do."

dialogues.jp: 環は微笑んで言う。
dialogues.en: Tamaki smiled as she talked.
dialogues.text: Tamaki smiled as she talked.

dialogues.jp: あれ？
dialogues.en: Ehhh?
dialogues.text: Ehhh?

dialogues.jp: なんか少し照れる。
dialogues.en: I starting feeling slightly self-concious.
dialogues.text: I starting feeling slightly self-concious.

dialogues.jp: 「環はどんなテレビが好きなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What kind of TV programs do you like?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of TV programs do you like?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね。私はテレビは見ませんから」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, that's right... I've never really watched television
before."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, that's right... I've never really watched television
before."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「げっ、マジで？」
dialogues.en: "Guh, really?"
dialogues.text: "Guh, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「家にテレビが無いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you have a TV at your home?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you have a TV at your home?"

dialogues.jp: そんな家が身近にあるとは……。
dialogues.en: That hits a little close to home...
dialogues.text: That hits a little close to home...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いいえ。ありますよ。テレビの受信料はきち
　んと払ってますもの」
dialogues.en:
"No, I do. We do pay the bills to maintain the television
and radio as well."
dialogues.text:
"No, I do. We do pay the bills to maintain the television
and radio as well."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよなあ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah, okay."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、何で見ない訳？」
dialogues.en: "But then, why don't you watch TV?"
dialogues.text: "But then, why don't you watch TV?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お勤めがあって、なかなか時間もないんです」
dialogues.en:
"I am often so busy with my duties that I do not have time
to watch, that's all..."
dialogues.text:
"I am often so busy with my duties that I do not have time
to watch, that's all..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「就寝時間も早いですし……。見るとしたら、
　ニュースぐらいですかね」
dialogues.en:
"I go to sleep early at night as well... usually, I am
content to watch the news on the television."
dialogues.text:
"I go to sleep early at night as well... usually, I am
content to watch the news on the television."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ニュースね。俺は逆に全然見ないな」
dialogues.en: "News, eh. Completely unlike me, basically."
dialogues.text: "News, eh. Completely unlike me, basically."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「最近はどんなニュースが流行ってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What kind of news has been in vogue recently?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of news has been in vogue recently?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「フフフ。流行ってるって、ファッションじゃ
　ないんですから……」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha ha, in vogue... news is not quite a type of fashion."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha ha, in vogue... news is not quite a type of fashion."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「同じようなものだ」
dialogues.en: "It's all the same to me."
dialogues.text: "It's all the same to me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうかもしれませんね」
dialogues.en: "I cannot say I agree with you there, then."
dialogues.text: "I cannot say I agree with you there, then."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「この前、イルカが川に迷い込んだというニュー
　スがやっていて、」
dialogues.en:
"The most recent story I saw was about a dolphin that
somehow got lost and ended up in a river."
dialogues.text:
"The most recent story I saw was about a dolphin that
somehow got lost and ended up in a river."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「目に釣り針が入ってる、って皆で救出する様
　子をテレビでやってましたよ」
dialogues.en:
"I was watching a rescue team try to drag the dolphin up
using a fish hook in order to transport it back to the sea."
dialogues.text:
"I was watching a rescue team try to drag the dolphin up
using a fish hook in order to transport it back to the sea."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん。環って、動物好きなの？」
dialogues.en: "He-eh. You like animals?"
dialogues.text: "He-eh. You like animals?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。動物には、不思議な力が宿る時もあり
　ますから」
dialogues.en: "Yes. They do possess have a mysterious power."
dialogues.text: "Yes. They do possess have a mysterious power."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「不思議な力？」
dialogues.en: "A mysterious power?"
dialogues.text: "A mysterious power?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「神が姿を変えて、下界に下りてきているとい
　う考えもあるくらいですから」
dialogues.en:
"It is said that when God descends down to this world, he
takes the form of an animal to observe the surroundings."
dialogues.text:
"It is said that when God descends down to this world, he
takes the form of an animal to observe the surroundings."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なるほどね……」
dialogues.en: "I see...."
dialogues.text: "I see...."

dialogues.jp:
環は、政治とか、経済にはあまり興味が無さそ
うだ。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki certainly doesn't seem like the type to be too
interested in politics or economics, with her religious
background.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki certainly doesn't seem like the type to be too
interested in politics or economics, with her religious
background.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、テレビより、私は本の方が好きですね」
dialogues.en:
"But generally, I prefer reading books over watching
television."
dialogues.text:
"But generally, I prefer reading books over watching
television."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Books?"
dialogues.text: "Books?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。恋愛小説とか……」
dialogues.en: "Yes, such as romance novels..."
dialogues.text: "Yes, such as romance novels..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん。どんなの読むの？」
dialogues.en: "He-eh. What are you reading now?"
dialogues.text: "He-eh. What are you reading now?"

dialogues.jp: 聞いたところで、知らない気もするが。
dialogues.en: Tamaki seemed slightly uncertain on how to answer.
dialogues.text: Tamaki seemed slightly uncertain on how to answer.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。源氏物語です」
dialogues.en: "Right now, Genji Monogatari."
dialogues.text: "Right now, Genji Monogatari."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「げ、源氏物語？　あの７人のアイドル？」
dialogues.en: "G, Genji Monogatari? That 7-strong boyband?"
dialogues.text: "G, Genji Monogatari? That 7-strong boyband?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　７人のアイドルって？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? That 7-strong boyband?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? That 7-strong boyband?"

dialogues.jp: ギャグが通じなかったか。
dialogues.en: That gag flew right over her head.
dialogues.text: That gag flew right over her head.

dialogues.jp:
たった今、『テレビは見ない』って聞いたばか
りなのに。
dialogues.en:
Now I can really believe her when she says that she doesn't
really watch TV at all.
dialogues.text:
Now I can really believe her when she says that she doesn't
really watch TV at all.

dialogues.jp: 「すまん。今のは聞かなかったことにしてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, just pretend I didn't say anything."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, just pretend I didn't say anything."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「平安時代、清少納言が書いたやつだよな」
dialogues.en:
"That was the book written in the Heian Period, by Sei
Shonagon."
dialogues.text:
"That was the book written in the Heian Period, by Sei
Shonagon."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「違いますよ。紫式部です」
dialogues.en: "Not quite. It was Murasaki Shikibu who wrote it."
dialogues.text: "Not quite. It was Murasaki Shikibu who wrote it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……そうそう。知ってて間違えた」
dialogues.en: "...Right, right. I knew it was wrong once I said it."
dialogues.text: "...Right, right. I knew it was wrong once I said it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「フフフ。面白い方……」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha ha, you're really quite amusing..."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha ha, you're really quite amusing..."

dialogues.jp: 環に、口に手を当てた｛みやび／雅｝な笑いをされてしまう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was politely covering her mouth during her giggles.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was politely covering her mouth during her giggles.

dialogues.jp: 今更、素で間違えたとは言えない……。
dialogues.en:
It's not surprising for me to be so slow-witted at this time
of the day though...
dialogues.text:
It's not surprising for me to be so slow-witted at this time
of the day though...

dialogues.jp: 「源氏物語は歴史小説だろ？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that a history novel, though?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that a history novel, though?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「違いますよ。立派な恋愛物語ですよ」
dialogues.en: "Not really. It's a fabulous romance novel."
dialogues.text: "Not really. It's a fabulous romance novel."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「恋愛ねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Romance, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Romance, huh..."

dialogues.jp:
あの話って、主人公がいろいろな女性に好かれ
る話だよな。
dialogues.en:
When that was said, the first thing that comes to my mind is
a main character with several girls madly in love with him.
dialogues.text:
When that was said, the first thing that comes to my mind is
a main character with several girls madly in love with him.

dialogues.jp: ハーレム。
dialogues.en: A harem.
dialogues.text: A harem.

dialogues.jp: 不意にそんな言葉が生まれてきた。
dialogues.en: Strange for that to pop up now...
dialogues.text: Strange for that to pop up now...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は読んだことありますか？」
dialogues.en: "Have you read that book before?"
dialogues.text: "Have you read that book before?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、俺は確か漫画で読んだ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I've read the manga before."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I've read the manga before."

dialogues.jp:
古文の授業があって、内容を覚えるために急い
で読んだ記憶がある。
dialogues.en:
As I had to study it for Literature before, I read the manga
for the overall story, to study for it.
dialogues.text:
As I had to study it for Literature before, I read the manga
for the overall story, to study for it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか。私は原文がやはり好きですね」
dialogues.en: "I see. I prefer reading the original text."
dialogues.text: "I see. I prefer reading the original text."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "O, original..."
dialogues.text: "O, original..."

dialogues.jp:
あんな訳の分からない宇宙語を……。読んだっ
て意味がわからない。
dialogues.en:
That kind of reasoning is completely alien to me... I
couldn't understand the original even if I tried.
dialogues.text:
That kind of reasoning is completely alien to me... I
couldn't understand the original even if I tried.

dialogues.jp: 「へえ、すげえな」
dialogues.en: "Heh, that's pretty amazing."
dialogues.text: "Heh, that's pretty amazing."

dialogues.jp: ある意味、感心する。
dialogues.en:
That she can understand that old literature, made my
admiration for her grow even more.
dialogues.text:
That she can understand that old literature, made my
admiration for her grow even more.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それほどでもないんですけどね」
dialogues.en: "It's not really anything special..."
dialogues.text: "It's not really anything special..."

dialogues.jp: 環は照れたのか、赤面して、俯く。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki bowed her head slightly, blushing red in
embarassment.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki bowed her head slightly, blushing red in
embarassment.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「源氏物語の女の人たちは、自分が源氏にとっ
　て唯一ではないとわかっていても、」
dialogues.en:
"All the women in Genji Monogatari neve ever stray from
Genji's side..."
dialogues.text:
"All the women in Genji Monogatari neve ever stray from
Genji's side..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「みんな好きな人のそばにいたいと思うんです
　よね」
dialogues.en: "Everyone always wants to be beside the one they love."
dialogues.text: "Everyone always wants to be beside the one they love."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それって、女心だなと思って」
dialogues.en: "That is the female psychology, anyway."
dialogues.text: "That is the female psychology, anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんなもんかね」
dialogues.en: "Is that so."
dialogues.text: "Is that so."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そう。女の子は、相手が自分を好きじゃない
　と思っていても、片思いでもいいから、そば
　にいたい……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. Women, even if the one they love does not love them
back, would rather be beside that person and harbour
unrequited love..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. Women, even if the one they love does not love them
back, would rather be beside that person and harbour
unrequited love..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それが乙女ごころってもんじゃないですか？」
dialogues.en: "That would be a typical girl's feelings, no?"
dialogues.text: "That would be a typical girl's feelings, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺は男だから、よくわからんな」
dialogues.en: "I'm a man, I wouldn't ever know."
dialogues.text: "I'm a man, I wouldn't ever know."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「男の人って、たくさんの女の人を好きになれ
　るものなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are men typically loved by lots of women?"
dialogues.text: "Are men typically loved by lots of women?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「うーん。人によりけりだと思うが……」
dialogues.en: "We-ll, I think that depends on the person..."
dialogues.text: "We-ll, I think that depends on the person..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様はどうですか？」
dialogues.en: "What is your experience, then?"
dialogues.text: "What is your experience, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺はそんなに器用じゃないからな」
dialogues.en: "I'm not so attractive as to know first-hand."
dialogues.text: "I'm not so attractive as to know first-hand."

dialogues.jp:
世の中には、１２人の妹から好かれる男もいる
ようだが……。
dialogues.en:
The only people I can think of, are those who love me more
like a brother than anything else...
dialogues.text:
The only people I can think of, are those who love me more
like a brother than anything else...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、好きになった人には一途になっていたい、
と思う。
dialogues.en: I've never whole-heartedly loved a person either.
dialogues.text: I've never whole-heartedly loved a person either.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「私だって、好きな人の側にはずっといたいで
　すよ」
dialogues.en:
"For myself, I would like to be by the side of the person I
love forever."
dialogues.text:
"For myself, I would like to be by the side of the person I
love forever."

dialogues.jp: と、急に環は俺の顔を見る。
dialogues.en: I quickly turn my head towards Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I quickly turn my head towards Tamaki.

dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、俺に向かって言われたのかと思った。
dialogues.en:
For a second, I thought that comment was directed towards
me,
dialogues.text:
For a second, I thought that comment was directed towards
me,

dialogues.jp: そんなわけ、無いよな。
dialogues.en: despite all evidence to the contrary.
dialogues.text: despite all evidence to the contrary.

dialogues.jp:
それよりも、環から、そんな大胆な発言が出る
とは思わなかったので、驚く。
dialogues.en:
And the very fact that Tamaki said such an outburst was
surprising in itself.
dialogues.text:
And the very fact that Tamaki said such an outburst was
surprising in itself.

dialogues.jp: と、同時に、何だか意識してしまう。
dialogues.en: So I guess my senses reacted as well.
dialogues.text: So I guess my senses reacted as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そう思いませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you think so?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you think so?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、ニッコリ微笑んで俺に語りかける。
dialogues.en: Tamaki spoke at me, smiling radiantly.
dialogues.text: Tamaki spoke at me, smiling radiantly.

dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺の態度はドギマギしている。
dialogues.en: My demeanour was still unsteady.
dialogues.text: My demeanour was still unsteady.

dialogues.jp: 必要以上に、環の言葉を意識している。
dialogues.en: I kept thinking of what Tamaki said.
dialogues.text: I kept thinking of what Tamaki said.

dialogues.jp: 何で意識してるんだ俺？
dialogues.en: What am I thinking of, seriously...
dialogues.text: What am I thinking of, seriously...

dialogues.jp: ◆環の恋愛論◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tamaki's Romance Argument◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tamaki's Romance Argument◆

dialogues.jp:
朝、あくびをしながら登校すると、校門前で環
に会い、眠そうなのを突っ込まれる。
dialogues.en:
In the morning, as I walked to school in a half-slumbering
state, I met Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
In the morning, as I walked to school in a half-slumbering
state, I met Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
深夜番組を見ていたと白状すると、環はほとん
どテレビを見ず、本が好きだと答える。
dialogues.en:
After confessing that I stayed up late to watch TV, and
asking her what kind of TV programs she liked, she replied
that she prefered books instead.
dialogues.text:
After confessing that I stayed up late to watch TV, and
asking her what kind of TV programs she liked, she replied
that she prefered books instead.

dialogues.jp:
『源氏物語』を原文で読み、結ばれないとわかっ
ていても一緒にいたいという乙女心を、環は俺
に語る。
dialogues.en:
"Genji Monogatari" especially, which she was reading the
original text of at the moment. She then extrapolated on how
it's natural for a woman to, despite having no links to the
man she loves, stay by his side forever.
dialogues.text:

dialogues.jp: 何だか、ガラにもなく意識してしまった。
dialogues.en: I wonder what she meant by that.
dialogues.text: I wonder what she meant by that.
